findings.title: TransferLeader makes a learner campaign; the learner's RaftCore panics
findings.scenario: U2 — transfer whose `to` node is not a voter
findings.update_attribution: introduced by the update: new RaftMsg::TransferLeader handler calls Engine::elect() without the is_voter guard used by ExternalCommand::Elect and handle_tick_election
findings.summary: The new RaftMsg::TransferLeader arm (core/raft_core.rs:1190-1202) calls engine.elect() whenever the node's vote equals `from` and the node is `to`, without the is_voter check that the two existing elect() callers apply. A learner that has accepted the leader's AppendEntries holds exactly that vote, so Raft::transfer_leader(from, to = learner), called on every node as documented, makes the learner a Candidate (violating ElectionByVoterOnly; docs/data/vote.md:50-51). The voters, whose leases the same transfer disabled, grant its higher vote and the old leader steps down; then the learner's own self-grant reaches Candidate::grant_by, whose progress contains only voters, and expect("target not in quorum set") panics (candidate.rs:92): the learner's Raft fails with Fatal::Panicked and the cluster is leaderless until another election timeout.
